# Andheri Physio Care

> Physiotherapy centre in Andheri East, Mumbai (PIN 400069). One-to-one sessions with a certified physiotherapist. Home visits available. See session and package prices before you book.

## Who we are
Andheri Physio Care is a Physiotherapy centre in Andheri East, Mumbai. 5 minutes from Andheri railway station and 8 minutes from Andheri airport. Landmark: Indira Tower, opposite the police station.
Treatments are led by Dr. Rajesh Menon, MPT (Musculoskeletal Sciences), Certified Sports Physiotherapist.

Every treatment page shows a transparent price range. An interactive cost estimator on /cost.html lets patients pick a treatment and a complexity/package option and shows the typical range immediately, with a pre-filled WhatsApp message. Written estimates are provided before treatment starts.

## FAQ (short answers)
Q: How long until I can return to work?
A: Most back pain patients return to desk work in 2–4 weeks with 6–8 sessions. Surgery rehab takes longer — we give you a week-by-week target.

Q: Do you come home?
A: Yes. We do home visits 7 days a week in Andheri and nearby areas. Same physiotherapist, same treatment — we bring the equipment.

Q: How long is one session?
A: 45–60 minutes. The first assessment is 45 minutes. Home visits are 45–60 minutes depending on your condition.

Q: Is physiotherapy painful?
A: Some stretching is uncomfortable — that is normal. We work within your pain limit and explain every step. Pain should never be sharp.

Q: When should I start after surgery?
A: Usually 3–7 days after, with your surgeon's permission. We get the discharge summary and start safely.

Q: How many sessions will I need?
A: Most problems improve in 6–12 sessions. Chronic pain and post-surgery rehab need 12–20. You will know the plan at the first assessment.
